Continue a simulation from the end of a fit or a previous run

Source: R/run.R
continue_parameter_sets.Rd

Run a model forward from the final state and time of a set of samples, with each sample continuing from its own state using its own parameters. The samples can be a fit from monty::monty_sample(), for projecting forward from the end of the data, or the result of run_parameter_sets() or of this function.

Usage

continue_parameter_sets(
  samples,
  times,
  obj = NULL,
  packer = NULL,
  pars = NULL,
  fixed = NULL,
  n_particles = NULL,
  deterministic = NULL,
  n_draws = NULL,
  state = NULL,
  time = NULL,
  save_trajectories = NULL,
  dt = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  n_threads = 1
)

Arguments

samples

A monty_samples object, from monty::monty_sample(), run_parameter_sets() or continue_parameter_sets().

times

Times to save output at, increasing and no earlier than the time being continued from.

obj

For a fit, the filter or unfilter the likelihood was created from. Not needed for output from run_parameter_sets().

packer

For a fit, the packer the likelihood was created with. Not needed for output from run_parameter_sets().

pars

Optional new parameter sets to use from this point on, in place of those in samples, in any form accepted by run_parameter_sets(). There must be one for each sample, in the same order, as each still continues from its own state. A data frame from posterior::as_draws_df() with some columns changed is the simplest way to do this.

fixed

Optional named list of parameters to hold constant from this point on, replacing fixed values used so far.

n_particles

Number of particles to run for each parameter set, each starting from that set's final state. If the samples already hold several particles per set, each particle continues from its own state and this must not be changed.

deterministic

Logical, indicating that a stochastic model should be run deterministically. By default this follows the fit (TRUE for an unfilter, FALSE for a filter) or the previous run.

n_draws

Optional number of parameter sets to select at random from pars. If given, the result has a single chain.

state, time

Optional state and time to continue from, instead of the final state. state has one column per sample, so a saved snapshot can be passed directly: samples$observations$snapshots[, 1, , ].

save_trajectories

Either TRUE, to save all state variables, or a character vector of variable names. By default the same variables as the previous run, or all of them for a fit.

dt

Time step, by default that of the fit or previous run.

seed, n_threads

Passed to dust2::dust_system_create().

Value

An object of class monty_samples, as for run_parameter_sets().

Details

For a fit, the final state must have been saved by creating the likelihood with save_state = TRUE (see dust2::dust_likelihood_monty()); it cannot be recovered afterwards. The filter is needed too, as it holds the model, its time step and the time of the last data point.

To start from somewhere other than the end, pass state and time explicitly, for example a snapshot saved with save_snapshots.
